name: sequence-mark
prompt: A 4:3 landscape original small editorial spot illustration for the personal website of a bioinformatics PhD researcher. Quiet conceptual image for representation learning, visually intelligible at 240 by 180 display pixels. Render at high native resolution with extremely clean smooth contours. A uniform warm ivory #FBF8F2 background with one compact motif in the center occupying 55 percent of the canvas: four gently looping flat navy #001F44 and muted blue #314E93 ribbons pass from a loose arrangement on the left into a simple organized weave on the right. Each ribbon is one smooth solid silhouette, no tiny repeated elements, no stripes inside ribbons. One small golden #E9BA35 segment at one junction. Plenty of space between ribbons, harmonious negative space. A restrained, modern Japanese editorial ink illustration with the crisp precision of a carefully drawn identity symbol; modest rather than spectacular. NO text, letters, paper texture, stippling, noisy print grain, micro-detail, engraving, hatching, shadows, gradients, 3D, glow, pseudo-photography, chart, arrows, frames or watermark. Avoid dense knots; the motif must be instantly legible and quiet.
disclosure: Original conceptual spot illustration, not experimental evidence. Native 1448×1086, displayed at most 300×225; lossless WebP.
